Oil shows a bullish bias despite mixed coverage, while the U.S. dollar and inflation retain mixed or bearish tones. Equities, AI, Bitcoin and gold all display bullish consensus but face conflicting headlines that temper outlooks. The strongest cross‑market theme is geopolitical risk driving oil, equities and crypto moves, while central‑bank policy and inflation data generate mixed signals for rates, dollar and gold.
